text:
Jamie (oncall): Pager alert: multiple load failures while warming model 'rdw-7b-q4' on node worker-83 in us-west-2. Getting OOM at init + deserialization errors. customer error RPS spiking.
IncidentBot: Auto-created incident INC-2026-091. Severity: P1. Affected: hosted inference (us-west-2), approx 12% error rate.
Ken (pager): seeing nvml driver panic logs and container restart loop on worker-83. GPU resets observed.
Maya (SRE): attaching condensed logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:45:03Z] model-init: alloc failed: mmap failed: Cannot allocate memory
[2026-03-17T02:45:05Z] deserialize: checksum mismatch for shard-12.bin
[2026-03-17T02:45:07Z] nvml: GPU 0 reset due to Page Fault
```
Lucas (Runtime Eng): This looks like a combo of paging pressure + a corrupted local artifact. If checksum mismatch, evict local cache and re-fetch from S3. But OOMs during mmap suggest host memory pressure too. What's host mem/swap?
Priya (Infra): worker-83 host mem 93% used, swap active, many concurrent warmups. Autoscaler didn't kick due to quota throttle. Provisioning 2 spare nodes in us-west-2 now.
Jamie (oncall): Mitigation plan (short): 1) drain warmups from worker-83 2) evict artifact cache for rdw-7b-q4 on worker-83 3) restart runtime-agent 4) reroute traffic to spare pool rdw-spare-ops-1. Executing step 1 now.
Maya (SRE): Step 1 done — stopped warmups, node marked DRAINING. Error rate dipped to ~9%.
Lucas (Runtime Eng): Running eviction + verify flow now:
```
sudo systemctl stop runtime-agent
rm -rf /var/cache/models/rdw-7b-q4/*
aws s3 cp s3://model-artifacts/rdw-7b-q4/sha256sum.sha256 /tmp/sha
sha256sum -c /tmp/sha
```
Restarting runtime-agent after fetch.
Jamie (oncall): runtime-agent restart succeeded. Logs show deserialization retry and fall back to re-download. Kicking off a single test warmup.
Morgan (Support): Customer TICKET-5421 (customer-acme): multiple failed requests reported. Notified customer that we're triaging; requested ETA. Suggested ETA: 30m.
Priya (Infra): New nodes finished joining, routing updated to shift ~60% of incoming warmup traffic to rdw-spare-ops-1.
Ken (pager): After artifact re-download warmup completed on worker-83. No OOM on the second attempt. nvml resets stopped.
Lucas (Runtime Eng): Root cause hypothesis: local shard file was truncated/corrupt on disk (checksum mismatch) and a concurrent warmup storm created host memory pressure -> heavy swap -> GPU page faults -> mmap OOM during model init. Fixes: atomic artifact writes + verify checksum before warmup + limit concurrent warmups per host.
Jamie (oncall): Customer impact summary: peak ~12% failed requests for hosted API in us-west-2; incident primary window ~42 minutes (first failure -> bulk recovery). No data exposure, only availability. SLA window impacted: 00:45-01:27 UTC.
Maya (SRE): Postmortem action items (short):
- infra: adjust autoscaler soft-quota + reserve warmup capacity per AZ (Priya)
- runtime: add prewarm checksum verification and atomic temp-file writes (Lucas)
- ops: implement warmup-concurrency guard per host (Jamie)
- support: customer communications + outreach template (Morgan)
Priya (Infra): I've bumped autoscaler target and reserved 3 warmup slots per AZ as a hotfix. Monitoring. Hotfix deploy scheduled to roll into prod in next 20m.
Jamie (oncall): Handoff to night oncall @Alex (oncall-nsd). Alex — please confirm checksum rollout and autoscaler metric changes in prod and monitor error rate.
Alex (oncall-nsd): Ack. I'll watch error rate for the next 4h and update this channel if anything regresses.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-091 marked mitigated by Jamie at 1799990300. Postmortem assigned to runtime + infra.
